summary.content:
Today's selection covers 99 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 58 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Who decides when AI is too dangerous?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Who decides when AI is too dangerous?
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
